title: momentum_scores row
description: Logical row for hypertable momentum_scores (see shared/databases/migrations/007_momentum.sql). MOMENTUM_SCANNER_PHASE1.md §4: exactly one score, momentum_score_100, an integer 0-100 measuring SETUP QUALITY — it does not predict a percentage gain. Only gated candidates are scored. Every sub-score is persisted separately alongside the pre-penalty subtotal so /score reconstructs the total exactly and Phase 2 can use components independently (§4.4). The +200/+300/+500/+1000 divisions are NOT built in Phase 1.

ts.description: The bar date t, matching momentum_features.ts

momentum_score_100.description: subtotal_before_penalties + penalty_total, clamped to [0,100], rounded to integer

score_vol_accel.description: 0-25 from vol_accel. Weight 25 measures whether volume is BUILDING (§4.1) — distinct from score_rvol

score_rvol.description: 0-20 from rvol_20. Weight 20 measures whether today is UNUSUAL vs the month (§4.1). The original brief's separate 'Volume +25' double-counted this; do not reintroduce a plain volume score

score_breakout.description: 0-20 from breakout_state: from_consolidation 20, breakout 14, approaching 8, none 0

subtotal_before_penalties.description: Sum of the seven sub-scores, before §4.3 penalties

penalty_total.description: Sum of applied penalties; negative or zero

penalties.description: Applied §4.3 penalties only. Keys: rsi_exhausted (-5, rsi_14 > 85), already_extended (-10, change_pct > 20), volume_decaying (-5, vol_accel < 1.0 AND rvol_20 >= 3). already_extended enforces the core thesis in the score itself — the system fires at +8-15% on a confirmed move, and a same-day +22% move is later in the sequence than the intended entry.

null_inputs.description: Feature names that were NULL and therefore scored 0 for their component. A null input scores zero and is never imputed (§4.2, §12).
